description: Search and browse AI models on Wiro. Each row shows the model's price; `get_model_schema` shows how it depends on settings such as resolution and checks it against them, so read the price there before you quote it or name a model as the cheapest. A price set when the run ends, or turn by turn in a live session, gives the rates, and the charge is known after the run. "No fixed price" means the run is charged for the time it takes. Choose a model and call the returned `get_model_schema` next action before using `run_model`.

search.description: One to three key words, e.g. "flux", "upscale" or "remove background"; each extra word narrows the results. It looks at each model's name and owner, its description, its parameters (id, label, placeholder, notes and help) and the option names of a selectwithcover field, such as an effect. Case, spaces, dots, dashes and underscores are ignored, and a short stem such as "timestamp" also finds the longer words that contain it.

sort.description: Sort by relevance, newest (time), number of ratings (ratedusercount), comments (commentcount) or average rating (averagepoint).

name: search_models

discountPercent.description: Your discount on this model, in percent. It comes off the part of a charge paid from deposits; coupon credit and store revenue pay first, at the list price in pricing.

estimatedCostUsd.description: Estimated USD cost of one run: the average of past runs for a model billed by run time, or the listed estimate of a price set when the run ends. Null when there is no such estimate, as for a model priced by its options: see pricing.

title: Search Wiro models
